skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply concepts related to single variable calculus including limits, continuity, derivatives, and integrals.
Understand and apply concepts related to multivariable calculus including partial derivatives, multiple integrals, and optimization problems.
Understand and apply basic economic functions such as supply, demand, cost, revenue, profit, production, marginal analysis, price elasticity, Lorenz curve, consumer surplus, and producer surplus.
Calculate limits of functions using various methods.
Calculate derivatives of functions using various methods.
Calculate indefinite and definite integrals using various methods.
Solve optimization problems involving single and multivariable functions with and without constraints.
Apply calculus concepts to solve real-world economic problems such as maximizing profits, minimizing costs, and analyzing market behavior.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve complex mathematical and economic problems.
Develop problem-solving skills to tackle complex mathematical and economic problems.
Develop independent study skills to learn and understand complex mathematical and economic concepts.
Work collaboratively with peers to solve complex mathematical and economic problems.
Assess own understanding and progress in learning mathematical and economic concepts.
